name: WISDM Activity Prediction Dataset
description: Smartphone accelerometer readings collected in controlled conditions for recognition of six activities: walking, jogging, upstairs, downstairs, sitting, and standing.
citation: Jennifer R. Kwapisz, Gary M. Weiss, and Samuel A. Moore. Activity Recognition using Cell Phone Accelerometers. Proceedings of the Fourth International Workshop on Knowledge Discovery from Sensor Data (KDD-10), 2010.
